use_case: AI-assisted emergency call triage: live transcription of calls with a suggested call type, response priority, and critical-keyword alerts inside CAD
business_owner: Chief Medical Officer (clinical); Vice President, Communications Centers (operational)
vendor_or_model: CAD vendor AI module (speech-to-text plus a language model classifier), vendor cloud service
data_categories: Live call audio; transcripts; caller-reported symptoms and location; suggested call type and priority (ePHI)
human_in_the_loop: Shadow mode today: suggestions are logged and never shown. Planned advisory mode: the dispatcher completes the emergency medical dispatch protocol and decides every priority; the AI may only prompt an upgrade, never a downgrade; no automatic dispatch
applicable_laws: HIPAA Privacy and Security Rules (BAA amendment signed 2026-07-30); 45 CFR 92.210 (patient care decision support tool); state call recording laws (Fla. Stat. 934.03(2)(g) worked example); state breach laws; FTC Act Section 5 (vendor claims)
status: Pilot (shadow mode at RCC-1 and RCC-2 since 2026-04-06; advisory mode not approved)
protected_characteristic_inputs: None as declared inputs; accuracy varies by caller language and patient age
bias_testing_status: Local shadow-mode testing by language and age (disparities found)
monitoring: Monthly under-triage and keyword sensitivity by language and age group

use_case: Demand forecasting and dynamic unit posting (system status management) recommending where idle ambulances wait
data_categories: Historical incident times and locations; unit status (no patient identifiers in model inputs)
human_in_the_loop: Supervisors approve each posting plan; dispatchers can override any move
applicable_laws: County agreements (response-time standards); FTC Act Section 5 (vendor claims)
patient_care_decision_support_tool_92_21: No (resource deployment, not a decision about a patient)
protected_characteristic_inputs: Location only; area-level demand can track income and rural status
bias_testing_status: Monthly response-time compliance by county zone, including rural and lower-income zones
monitoring: Monthly response-time compliance by zone; quarterly forecast error
